GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 451 (8 Jul 50) CCS
(SCAPIN-2114)
APO 500
8 July 1950
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Release of Vehicles and Trailers.
1. Reference memorandum for the Japanese Government, AG 451 (27 Sep 46)CCS, SCAPIN 1235, 27 September 1946, subject: Loan of Vehicles and Trailers for Use in Connection With Maintenance of Occupation Forces Communications Service.
2. Above referenced memorandum is hereby rescinded.
3. All vehicles and trailers listed in Appendix No. 1 to referenced memorandum are released to the Japanese Government and will be registered in the name of the Ministry of Telecommunications.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
K.B.BUSH
Brigadier General, USA
Adjutant General
